<h2>Validate an sjSDM Artifact Envelope</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Validates the common v2 envelope, registered payload names, provenance,
and deterministic content hash.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>validate_sjsdm_artifact_envelope(
  list_artifact = NULL,
  expected_artifact_type = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="list_artifact">list_artifact</code></td>
<td>
<p>Named list containing one persisted v2 artifact.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="expected_artifact_type">expected_artifact_type</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional character scalar required artifact type.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Invisible 'TRUE'. Invalid artifacts abort.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
validate_sjsdm_artifact_envelope(
  list_artifact = list_sjsdm_cv_prediction_artifact,
  expected_artifact_type = "sjsdm_cv_predictions"
)

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>

</main>
